messages:
Ava (Marketing): Quick ask — need a compact benchmark tile set (3 sizes) for the 'Serving Wins' webinar. Key stats: 2x p95 latency improvement, ~40% lower per-token cost, 99.9% SLA. Reuse micro-hero template and include a one-pager for sales.
Sam (Design): Got it. Which visual treatment? Minimal iconography or illustrated?
Ava (Marketing): Minimal. Elements: comparison sparkline, cost-per-token callout, small methods footnote. Need dark and light variants.
Priya (Growth): Also need a 1:1 social card and a 16:9 webinar hero slide. CTAs: Register / Request demo / Watch on-demand.
Sam (Design): ETA? I can mock 3 tiles + slide if scope is firm.
Tomas (Prod PM): Please attach benchmark numbers and final microcopy; want to avoid post-design copy churn.
Ava (Marketing): Data snapshot: p95 measured on production web-chat workload; baseline = open-serve v2. Copy ideas: header: '2x faster p95 latency†' body: 'Reduces per-token cost by ~40% on typical sequences' footnote: '†p95 measured on web-chat workload; see methods link.'
Sam (Design): Legal/brand flags? Accessibility targets?
Ava (Marketing): Legal cleared claims if footnote + methods link included. Accessibility: aim for 4.5:1 text contrast; large numeric callouts may use Brand Teal.
Miguel (Brand): Brand note — avoid orange as primary accent. Use Teal 700 for callouts, Neutral backgrounds. Use official icon set only.
Sam (Design): Roger. Creating Figma file with color tokens & export specs.
FigmaBot: New file created by Sam: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh-1755009999/serving-wins-bench-assets (marketing-team view)
Priya (Growth): Lead routing requirements: utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=serving-wins and hidden form field 'workload_type' values: [chat, embedding]. Sales also wants a PDF cheat-sheet with talking points.
Ava (Marketing): We'll hand off tracking to ops, include sales one-pager in asset pack.
Sam (Design): Adding 1-page 'sales cheat' template to Figma; will export PDF-ready.
Ava (Marketing): Timeline: copy lock Wed EOD, design final Fri AM, exports by Fri 12:00 PT so growth can schedule.
Sam (Design): Tight but doable if copy locked by Wed. Drop final copy and legal link here.
Ava (Marketing): Final copy: 'Serving wins: 2x faster p95 latency, ~40% lower per-token cost — Redwood Inference.' Methods link: https://redwood.inference/benchmarks/methods
Ava (Marketing): Sales cheat bullets: 1) test context (web-chat, 8–16 token prompts), 2) baseline device, 3) cost math example (per 1k tokens), 4) objection handling lines.
Sam (Design): Uploaded previews. Light: https://redwood.ai/s3/preview/bench-light-1755009999.png Dark: https://redwood.ai/s3/preview/bench-dark-1755009999.png Slide mock: https://redwood.ai/s3/preview/bench-slide-1755009999.png
Priya (Growth): Prepping UTMs and tracking snippet; will confirm field names by Thu.
Miguel (Brand): Final export checklist: SVG icons, color tokens, kerning check for big numbers, PNG @2x for social.
Sam (Design): Added accessible swatches and alt copy notes. README page added with routing and legal footnote.
Ava (Marketing): :thumbsup: Sam — please upload final assets and README.
Sam (Design): Final package upload scheduled Fri 11:30am PT.
Ava (Marketing): Priya, Tomas — I'll DM the lead-routing JSON for registration form integration.
Priya (Growth): Thanks — I'll validate with analytics.
Tomas (Prod PM): I'll coordinate with frontend on tracking fields.
Ava (Marketing): Closing: keep tile copy tight, avoid hype, keep metrics precise. Will loop back if legal requests changes. Thanks team!
